payload.summary: The external auditor's certificate closing the 2023/24 audit, signed on 1 June 2026. Almost all of it is one finding, carried over from the 2024/25 audit report because it applies to 2023/24 too: a significant weakness in the council's arrangements for overseeing the companies it owns. Ernst & Young says the council "did not have effective policies, procedures, or governance arrangements for overseeing its part owned and wholly owned subsidiary companies", that this "exposed the Council - and ultimately local taxpayers - to an increased risk of financial loss", and that "Based on the evidence available, there is no indication that adequate oversight arrangements for subsidiaries have ever existed, dating back to the subsidiary's incorporation in November 2015". The auditor classes it as a weakness in governance and in improving economy, efficiency and effectiveness, and tells the council to rewrite its constitution.
